options.label: Single Prompt

options.label: Single Prompt (Responses API)
options.description: Send a request to the Responses API to generate a text-only model output using selected model and input text.

options.label: Multiple Prompts
options.description: Send a chat completion request to a selected model. The request must contain a “messages” array. All advanced options from the base request are also supported.

options.label: Multiple Prompts (Responses API)
options.description: Send a request to the Responses API to generate a response for a chat-style interaction using your selected model. Provide the conversation as a messages array.
